description: Yoteiko is an AI-powered travel planner for destinations worldwide. Search for attractions, restaurants, and hidden gems across any country, then get a personalized day-by-day itinerary built by AI. Whether you're planning a weekend in Paris, a two-week Japan rail trip, or a backpacking adventure through Southeast Asia, Yoteiko creates tailored plans with local recommendations, transit tips, and timing suggestions.
